organizations.name: Braven
organizations.description:
Braven is an organization focused on teaching students valuable career skills not otherwise taught in traditional school programs. As a fellow, I completed their "Career Accelerator Course": a collection of workshops focused on teaching career skills like networking, leadership skills, and professional communication. 

The course ended with a 5 week team design challenge, sponsored by Credit Karma, where fellows competed developing the best solution to Credit Karma's problem statement: "How can we help sub-prime credit users get better access to credit cards and help them champion financial progress"
